gloss: to suit, to match, to become

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {似合|にあ}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to suit, to look good on
definitions.explanation: For something to be appropriate for someone's appearance.

definitions.gloss: to match, to go well with
definitions.explanation: For things to harmonize well together.

notes:
{似合|にあ}う means to suit, match, or look good on someone.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)
- Takes ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ particle for the person/thing being suited

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{似合|にあ}う: to suit ~, to look good on ~
- お{似合|にあ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧: a well-matched couple
- ⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{似合|にあ}わず: contrary to one's age
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{似合|にあ}わない: doesn't suit ~

ASPECT (ている):
{似合|にあ}っている describes the current state of something suiting well: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧、{似合|にあ}っている⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧ (Those clothes look good on you).

RELATED WORDS:
- {似合|にあ}い: suitability, match (noun)
- お{似合|にあ}い: well-matched (polite, often for couples)
- {似合|にあ}いの: suitable, matching (attributive)
